name: Stepfinch
description: Turns a task you do once into a step-by-step guide: a screenshot of every click, the steps written for you, private info blurred. Everything stays on your Mac.
terms: No code, applied at checkout. One payment: up to 3 Macs, every update. 3 guides free to try first. $39 from Dec 2. Apple silicon, macOS 14+.
